coverage: Combined encrypted snapshot survives actual page reload
Wrong password rejects and explicit retry restores
Injected IndexedDB quota failure preserves old copy and retry input
Removing one selected copy leaves another
Existing role storage journal/file recovery and device-copy unlock
Real IndexedDB concurrent revision writes, quota mapping, deletion and late committed completion remain covered

limits: Combined saves are explicit manual checkpoints; no autosave or pre-wallet journal added.
A saved browser copy is local to its origin/profile and can be removed by eviction or clearing site data.
Shared adapter regression preserves existing role storage schema; browser tests compile both actual driver and adapter sources.
Native-wallet recovery, physical power-loss persistence, full regression and runtime image refresh are not claimed.
